blocks.title: Monitoring Resources and Core Activities comparison
Monitoring Resources and Core Activities exam shortcuts
items: Logs from many systems need one searchable location → LOG AGGREGATION
Centralize telemetry so analysts can correlate events.
Example: Firewall, server, and authentication logs feed one SIEM.
Security team needs immediate notification → ALERTING
Alerts call attention to conditions that meet rules or thresholds.
Example: Ten failed logins generate an alert.
Need to identify known weaknesses → SCANNING
Use scanning to look for vulnerabilities or exposures.
Example: A vulnerability scanner checks servers for missing patches.
Need historical evidence months later → ARCHIVING
Archive security records for retention and later investigation.
Example: Authentication logs are kept for one year.
Translate monitoring results into usable summaries.
Example: A monthly dashboard shows incident and vulnerability trends.
blocks.example: Focus on whether the scenario is asking for visibility, detection, containment, validation, or a specific monitoring tool.

questions.q: A company sends firewall, server, and authentication logs to one central platform for correlation. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: Log aggregation centralizes logs from multiple sources for analysis and correlation.

questions.q: A rule generates a notification after ten failed logins from one account. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: Alerting notifies analysts when a defined condition occurs.

questions.q: A security team checks servers for missing patches and known vulnerabilities. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: Scanning checks systems for vulnerabilities or exposures.

questions.q: A company keeps authentication logs for one year for compliance and later investigations. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: Archiving stores records for long-term retention.

questions.q: Leadership receives a monthly dashboard showing incident and vulnerability trends. Which activity is this?
questions.explanation: Reporting communicates security status and trends to stakeholders.

questions.q: An analyst reviews operating-system events and endpoint telemetry for suspicious behavior. What is being monitored?
questions.explanation: System monitoring focuses on hosts, endpoints, servers, and operating-system events.
